SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED. Fresh consumer, not a resume backup. No execution by implementer.
Only Xe b9f00e9db7fd56decdd9930ee84049d980b904e4 startup then model32768+GEN16.
Namespace B/main-current-xe-b9-pristine-model-root-v1/{xe-startup,xe-model}; no old roots adopted.
Seven local Python helpers plus exact external direct_owner.py SHA a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f.
Owner pin is checked before import; all seven source hashes are required at admission and throughout the run.
Private paths and provider/model facts are user/Main-supplied diagnostic bindings, not product defaults.
Parent actual source bytes, not stale parent manifest/pending hashes, define the derivation.

Policy changes: new tree/revision/binary path; binary SHA PENDING_MAIN_B9_BINARY_SHA; Xe-only sequence,
CLI engine choices and admission. Only source LLVM7.1.1 provider/native adapter, no ICPX/MKL prerequisites.
STRATA_COPY_ENGINE=0 added to identical phase health/model environment; NEOReadDebugKeys1,
EnableDirectSubmission0, UR_L0_V2_FORCE_DISABLE_COPY_OFFLOAD1, barrier event marker, inline issuer0,
CPU share/gate0, requested ring8, ARENA_HOST_USM1, DEVICE_PLAN0, SEGMENTED1 preserved.
Ring8 is source-clamped to at least16 at8192. STRATA_PREFILL_FIRST0 is retained but has no b9 consumer found.
No unsupported preload/same-queue recipe, pipeline/batch, model or algorithm added.
All prior controlled CLI values retained, including native model/PLE/profile, physical context262144,
int8/resident32768, cache128/per-layer, workers5, PCIe0, swaps0, prompt/conversation caches0,
suffix-draft0, no MTP, greedy, short-read0, spec4, prefill8192, experts16, no-prefill-borrow.
Trace parser remains exact: four chunks0/8192/16384/24576 of32767, full PP progression,
RESUME0/REUSED0, sixteen T/finite unique-top5 LP pairs, final16-field DONE length/read_n32768.
Individual samples/fingerprint are output-scope diagnostics, not full-vocab parity or quality/speed.

No inferred absence of unsafe host polling is asserted by policy flags. R306 describes legacy doorbell hazards;
Main must reconcile it with actual --native qwen4exp verifier/prefill/init/teardown call routes on these323 pinned
source files. Both q and immutable source_route_review must affirm copy_engine_disabled_reviewed and
selected_route_has_no_concurrent_host_device_polling. They stay false here. Integer health/visibility probes,
old successful da3d output or an unselected legacy function do not alone resolve this safety gate. If Main cannot
prove the selected route meets the requested contract, no owner/model startup is admitted. Production source
must remain pristine; a repaired binary requires a separately named diagnostic packet/admission, not relabeling.

All parent bounds retained: nonblocking exclusive owned-v0141-measurement.lock;300s startup/1800s whole model
wall; cumulative child CPU3600s; stdout+stderr64MiB/perfile64MiB/allroot96MiB; model sessionRSS88GiB,
utilityRSS4GiB;256 FDs/core0 owner limits; model and visible cgroup reserve80GiB; bounded progress30s.
Model source/build/tool/input/library pin checks,4GiB selected mapping budget and exact owned PID/start/exe/argv/env
checks unchanged. Qualified owner alone performs identity-pinned emergency enforcement; forced cleanup cannot PASS.
Normal QUIT/30s exit at responsive idle/DONE/ERR boundary; errors retained. No reset/unbind/service changes/retry.
Fresh<=120s sameboot Main health with exact provider/env/library/integer protocol, BDF normal<=256MiB,
fresh journal cursor/devcoredump gates before/after/final; startup review pin required before model.
All errors/partial/cancelled runs remain failed and block the new namespace prefix.
Credential-tainted receipt is rejected before hash/read. No broad inherited environment is admitted.

Production source capture323files is not compilation, provider/property or runtime qualification.
Main must resolve exact new binary, compiler/macro/build receipts and source subset against original build closure,
new seven-file CPU/review receipts, provider mapped library/stat/build-ID manifests and actual health wrappers,
native/PLE/model inputs and source-format device stderr. All placeholders and Main booleans remain unresolved.
Main must create a configured derivative when replacing the binary SHA, re-pin all code and CPU/review proofs,
not overwrite this immutable SourceOnly packet or reuse older controller CPU qualification as validity.
Official protocol cases and official CPU mock remain unit fixtures only: no official production tree or sequence.
